title: Red's Minimalistic Progression
description: Slow things down a bit, make each step more special
body:
# Red's Minimalistic Progression
This datapack aims to lengthen out the progression of the game, while changing as few things as possible. There are no custom items, no new mechanics, it's all just small tweaks.

Currently the pack only changes the speed at which tools are acquired, and the time it takes to get a bed

All edits are subject to change, thoughts, Ideas, and feedback are welcome

<details>
<summary>All Changes</summary>
  
  Sheep don't drop wool on death
  
  Wood/Stone Tools can't break stone/deepslate or deepslate ore
  
  Stone Tools can't break iron/copper ore, can break gold ore
  
  Iron Tools can't break deepslate or deepslate diamond ore
</details>
